profileOverview.title: Profile & overview
profileOverview.description: Complete your avatar and profile, and see where things live in the app.
profileOverview.step1Body: On the left you find the app areas. Move the mouse over the menu to show the labels next to the icons.
profileOverview.step2Body: Here you see your upcoming activities and quick actions to create an activity or report damage.
profileOverview.step3Body: Overview of all activities and a way to create new ones. Step-by-step creation is covered in the separate «Create activity» tour.
profileOverview.step4Body: Overview of stock in the warehouse. Use the eye icon to open an item’s detail view.
profileOverview.step5Body: Contacts and event locations. You can also create a new address here.
profileOverview.step6Body: Your open tasks — for example when an activity needs your attention.
profileOverview.step7Body: Messages appear when something happens, you need to act, or material is ready to pick up.
profileOverview.step8Body: View your department and set the primary (main) department. Under Groups you see who belongs where.
profileOverview.step9Body: Top right you can quickly search activities, material and more.
profileOverview.step10Body: Your avatar with initials and colour. Click it to open the user menu.
profileOverview.step11Body: Here you switch between departments if you belong to more than one.
profileOverview.step12Body: Open «Edit profile» to update name, avatar and other details.
profileOverview.step13Body: Last name, first name and email. If you change the email, you must confirm the new address via a verification email.
profileOverview.step14Body: Nickname and initials appear on your avatar. Language applies to the whole app.
profileOverview.step15Body: Change your password here — only when you want to update it.
profileOverview.step16Body: Optional: your home address. Used internally for orders to external parties (J+S and others) and stored as a user address in contacts.
profileOverview.step17Body: Choose background and text colour for your avatar so you are recognised in lists and groups.
profileOverview.step18Body: Click Save to finish the tour. Without changes the profile just closes — with data entered, it is saved (e.g. for J+S).

materialCreate.title: Capture material
materialCreate.description: Add a single item step by step — through to save.
materialCreate.step2Body: Start the wizard to capture material.
materialCreate.step3Body: For getting started, pick «Single item» — one physical piece of material.
materialCreate.step4Body: First enter only the item name (e.g. «Steel peg»). Next come the toggles and the category.
materialCreate.step5Body: Between name and category are two toggles. «Consumable» or «Food» change the rest of the wizard (different fields and flow). For this tour leave both off and click «Next». Separate tours: «Consumables» and «Food».
materialCreate.step6Body: Pick a category (or create one with +). Without a category you cannot continue.
materialCreate.step7Body: Click «Bulk» (quantity) or «Serialized» (each piece with SN). For this tour bulk works best — then you continue to stock.
materialCreate.step8Body: Choose the stock unit (e.g. pieces or metres). That controls how quantities are entered.
materialCreate.step9Body: Enter the initial quantity. Without a quantity you cannot set a storage site or save.
materialCreate.step10Body: Purchase date is required (except for food). It belongs to the batch / goods receipt.
materialCreate.step11Body: Enter purchase price and shipping costs — important for valuation and accounting. Invoice number and receipt are optional.
materialCreate.step12Body: Code and EAN belong to the item — often from the manufacturer (QR/barcode on the product). Once captured here, the material can be found again in eMatChef by scanning. Optional: you can leave them empty and add later.
materialCreate.step13Body: Optional: split stock across several sites. For getting started leave it off — one location is enough.
materialCreate.step14Body: Pick the storage site (address). Use + to add one if needed. Racks/slots are under Settings → Storage.
materialCreate.step15Body: Much of this is optional — but weight is especially worth entering:
step15Items: Weight: so you know how heavy the material for an activity will be — useful for planning vehicles and transport.
Add pack size and dimensions where useful for storage and lending.
Optional: manufacturer/supplier, model, description and PDF (e.g. datasheet).
Next comes the «Rental» section — then you can create the item.
materialCreate.step16Body: Optional: set rental prices and terms if this material can be rented out. After that you can create the item.
materialCreate.step17Body: When required fields are done, click «Add material». That creates the item and finishes the tour.

activityCreate.title: Create activity
activityCreate.description: Create a simple activity (e.g. Saturday activity) in the current wizard.
activityCreate.step2Body: Click «+ New activity» to open the wizard.
activityCreate.step3Body: Choose type «Activity» for short group events (e.g. Saturday). Unlike camp/event: no release step in between — the request goes straight to the material manager. Camp and events have their own tours.
activityCreate.step4Body: Name and group — then dates and material as separate steps.
activityCreate.step5Body: Enter the usage time — the calendar offers shortcuts like “Next Saturday”. Pickup/return appears just below; next comes material.
activityCreate.step6Body: The search is focused and shows practice materials (e.g. tarp) with available quantity. Add amounts with the buttons. Next: «Submit» to the material manager — you can still add items later in the «Material» tab.
activityCreate.step7Body: Click «Submit» — the request goes straight to the material manager. Afterwards the activity details open.
activityCreate.step8Body: Here you see the submitted activity with usage and material pickup/return. Check the dates briefly — «Next» opens the «Material» tab.
activityCreate.step9Body: In the «Material» tab you can still reorder or add lines until the material manager starts «Accept & pack». Then finish with «Tour done».

activityCampCreate.title: Create camp
activityCampCreate.description: Multi-day camp with dates, venue, optional J+S and invites — through submit & release.
activityCampCreate.step2Body: Click «+ New activity» to open the wizard.
activityCampCreate.step3Body: Choose «Camp» for multi-day camps with material lead/lag times.
activityCampCreate.step4Body: Give the camp a name and pick the group — both are basic data.
activityCampCreate.step5Body: Search an existing event venue or create one with «+».
activityCampCreate.step6Body: «+» opens event-venue creation. If you already searched and selected, just continue.
activityCampCreate.step7Body: Check the name above or below (venue name) — it is synced. Set the pin on the map, then tap «Set event venue».
activityCampCreate.step8Body: Under the venue you can add a delivery / drop-off point — where material is delivered. Tap «Next» or «Capture delivery location».
activityCampCreate.step9Body: Important: set the storage/drop-off pin on the map. Fill name plus street, ZIP and city — you can derive the address from the pin or open Google Maps to copy it. «Create»/«Save» advances the tour.
activityCampCreate.step10Body: Optional: include J+S material. You will need participant count later for dotation.
activityCampCreate.step11Body: Invite departments that use eMatChef so you can share material at the joint event.
activityCampCreate.step12Body: Tap «Next» in the tour — that also triggers the wizard «Next» button and saves the draft.
activityCampCreate.step13Body: Set when the camp takes place.
activityCampCreate.step14Body: Pickup/return windows sit around usage and drive availability.
activityCampCreate.step15Body: With J+S enabled: enter participant count for dotation. Without J+S, continue.
activityCampCreate.step16Body: Tap «Next» in the tour — that triggers the wizard «Next» and opens the material step.
activityCampCreate.step17Body: The search shows practice materials with quantities — add lines. Then «Next» (tour or wizard) to the overview.
activityCampCreate.step18Body: Check the summary. Drafts are visible to you, your group and permitted roles — not yet to MW for packing.
activityCampCreate.step19Body: Click «Save draft» at the bottom right — then activity details open.
activityCampCreate.step20Body: Here you see the camp with usage and material times. Next: the tabs.
activityCampCreate.step21Body: In overview you edit basics and dates while still draft / before packing.
activityCampCreate.step22Body: In «Material» you can still add or change lines until MW starts packing.
activityCampCreate.step23Body: Assign vehicles for transport — search the fleet or reuse known ones.
activityCampCreate.step24Body: With J+S material: dotation and order form. Without J+S the tab is missing — continue.
activityCampCreate.step25Body: Important: «Submit» sends the camp for release. Without submit it stays a draft — MW will not pack.
activityCampCreate.step26Body: After submit, leadership/group chef must «Confirm» (release). Only then can MW accept and pack.

issueReturn.title: Accept & pack
issueReturn.description: After release: accept a camp preferably (or an activity) and learn packing with/without scan (MW/DC).
issueReturn.step1Body: Filter «In progress» (automatic) — the list shows released camps/events and packable activities. Camps are preferred for the highlight.
issueReturn.step2Body: Double-click the highlighted row (camp preferred, otherwise activity) — or «Continue» in the tour opens the details.
issueReturn.step3Body: Check usage and material pickup/return before you accept.
issueReturn.step4Body: In the «Material» tab you see the demand. If it looks right, continue to Accept & pack.
issueReturn.step5Body: Tap «Accept & pack» at the top — status becomes «Packing». Then we explain the packing list (you do not need to pack now).
issueReturn.step6Body: At the top you see the journey (Pack → Issue → …). For this tour stay on packing — look only, do not book anything.
issueReturn.step7Body: At the top: camera/scan field. Scan a material QR (or shelf) — confirm the hit, and the line counts as packed. You do not need to scan during the tour.
issueReturn.step8Body: Below, the packing list: tap a line or set quantity and book with the arrow — no scanner. Explanation only; you do not need to pack now.
issueReturn.step9Body: You know accept and packing now. Later you pack here with scan or list. Issue and return follow in the next tour.

categoriesTour.title: Manage categories
categoriesTour.description: Build your material structure with templates or your own categories.
categoriesTour.step3Body: Suggestion: apply standard categories (pioneer, kitchen, tent, …). Click «Apply templates».
categoriesTour.step4Body: Choose what to create. Existing names are struck through. Continue closes the dialog — or click Cancel / Apply and the tour continues as well.
categoriesTour.step5Body: Create individual categories manually. Click «New category».
categoriesTour.step6Body: Here you see name and parent category (main category or a child under it). You do not need to type anything — just click Continue.
categoriesTour.step7Body: Click Continue here, then close the form with Cancel (or save if you created something).
categoriesTour.step8Body: Use the pencil to edit a category, the trash to delete it. Plus adds a subcategory.
categoriesTour.step9Body: You can create and manage categories now — or browse more tours.

inviteUsers.title: Invite team
inviteUsers.description: Bring more leaders into your department.
inviteUsers.step2Body: In the settings navigation, open «My department» — members and invites live there.
inviteUsers.step3Body: Use the search field to quickly find someone in the list — by name or email.
inviteUsers.step4Body: Invite new people here. Click «Add user».
inviteUsers.step5Body: Type a name or email (at least 3 characters). Pick a match from the list — if no one is found, you can invite by email below (address + role).
inviteUsers.step6Body: Click Continue — the form closes via Cancel. Use «Send invite» later for a real invite.
inviteUsers.step7Body: The pencil opens a member’s details. Click the pencil.
inviteUsers.step8Body: At the top you edit name, email, nickname, initials and language — like in your own profile.
inviteUsers.step9Body: J+S and orders need a private address. Add it here in the «Address» section.
inviteUsers.step10Body: You can invite members and manage their details now — or browse more tours.

defaultCoach.title: Set default coach
defaultCoach.description: Mark a member as J+S coach — for orders and allocation.
defaultCoach.step2Body: Open «My department» — members are managed there.
defaultCoach.step3Body: The pencil opens a member’s details. Click the pencil.
defaultCoach.step4Body: Under membership, tick «J+S coach». They then appear as coach for J+S orders.
defaultCoach.step5Body: Coach set — you can mark more members this way or browse other tours.

departmentDetails.title: Department details
departmentDetails.description: Set storage locations, racks/slots and the billing address for your department.
departmentDetails.step2Body: Open «My department» — that’s where you manage department master data and addresses.
departmentDetails.step3Body: Under «Storage locations» you record the physical places where material is stored (address, map, primary site).
departmentDetails.step4Body: Use «Add» to create a location. Mark one as primary, edit or delete — the map shows the position when coordinates exist.
departmentDetails.step5Body: Next: racks and slots. Click «Storage» in the settings navigation.
departmentDetails.step7Body: Pick the location, base name and count. You can add a slot per rack right away (e.g. D1) — location → rack → slot in one go. Then «Save».
departmentDetails.step8Body: The list shows locations with racks. Expand a rack and use + to add more slots. Without slots you can barely assign material later.
departmentDetails.step9Body: Back to «My department»: under «Billing address» you store company name and address for invoices and official correspondence.
departmentDetails.step10Body: Edit existing addresses with the pencil. If none exists yet, create one with «Add».
departmentDetails.step11Body: Locations, racks/slots and billing address are set — you can store material properly.

tours.lockedRequiresApprovedActivity: First create an activity or camp and release it (status «Approved»).

materialConsumable.title: Consumables
materialConsumable.description: Create a consumable item — e.g. packing paper (by the metre) with stock and sale price.
materialConsumable.step2Body: Click «+ New material» to open the wizard — e.g. packing paper, film or other consumables.
materialConsumable.step3Body: Choose «Individual item» — consumables are created like a normal article.
materialConsumable.step4Body: First enter the item name — e.g. «Packing paper». Next comes the «Consumable» toggle.
materialConsumable.step5Body: Turn on «Consumable». Then usage is booked instead of returning like loaned gear. Leave «Food» off.
materialConsumable.step6Body: Pick a suitable category (or create one with +). Without a category you cannot continue.
materialConsumable.step7Body: Choose «Bulk» (quantity, e.g. packing paper in metres) or «Serialized» (each piece with SN). For packing paper, bulk fits — click the option.
materialConsumable.step8Body: Choose «pcs» or «m». With «m», a dialog asks for the default length (metres per unit/roll) — changeable per batch later. For packing paper: «m».
materialConsumable.step9Body: Enter quantity, purchase date and purchase price. Optional: packaging unit (e.g. metres per roll).
materialConsumable.step10Body: Under Details: set sale price and reference purchase price — without them, consumption cannot later be charged in CHF.
materialConsumable.step11Body: When the required fields are set, click «Add material». That creates the consumable item.

materialFood.title: Food
materialFood.description: Create food items — e.g. jam with expiry dates and batches.
materialFood.step2Body: Click «+ New material» — e.g. jam, drinks or snacks.
materialFood.step3Body: Choose «Individual item» — food is created like an article; the wizard adapts afterwards.
materialFood.step4Body: First enter the item name — e.g. «Jam». Next comes the «Food» toggle.
materialFood.step5Body: Turn on «Food». Serialized tracking is disabled; you work with quantities and expiry. Leave «Consumable» off.
materialFood.step6Body: Pick or confirm the category. Without a category you cannot continue.
materialFood.step7Body: Per batch enter quantity and expiry date (required); purchase date is optional. Use «+ Batch» for more lots with their own best-before — consume earliest expiry first.
materialFood.step8Body: Under Details: reference purchase and sale price (0.00 is allowed). Food does not create an accounting cost booking — it is already covered by the activity.
materialFood.step9Body: Optional: fill required fields and click «Add material». Or just look around — use «Tour done» to finish without creating anything.

issueHandoff.title: Loans, damage & wet return
issueHandoff.description: After packing: loans, report repairs/losses, and wet returns.
issueHandoff.step1Body: Under «In progress» you see packed events. That is where issue and return start.
issueHandoff.step2Body: Open the demo (demo_camp, at event) — then you click the journey steps yourself.
issueHandoff.step3Body: Click «Loans» in the journey — you switch the step yourself (as in daily use).
issueHandoff.step4Body: Report damage and losses on the line item so stock stays correct and the workshop knows.
issueHandoff.step5Body: Click «Return» — there you mark wet or dirty material.

activityStore.title: Store material
activityStore.description: After return: put material back into storage (MW/DC).
activityStore.step1Body: In the activities list you find events after return — that is where storing starts.
activityStore.step2Body: Use «In progress» to see ongoing pack/return flows. Open an activity with status «Returned» or «Storing».
activityStore.step3Body: When everything is returned, start «Storing» — the material journey shows the «Store» step.
activityStore.step4Body: Per line (or pack crate): check quantity, scan or pick rack/slot, and book in. Wet material goes to the drying queue.
activityStore.step5Body: When everything is stored, the activity can be completed. Department chefs continue with the «Complete» tour.

activityClose.title: Complete activity
activityClose.description: As department chef: after storing, check costs/tickets and complete the activity.
activityClose.step1Body: Material is back in storage. Check open workshop tickets and cost releases.
activityClose.step2Body: Clear open reports, costs and missing material before completing.
activityClose.step3Body: Completing finishes the journey — the activity leaves the packing flow.

activityApprove.title: Release camp & event
activityApprove.description: Optional: review and release submitted camps/events. With onboarding practice data the demo camp is auto-approved — you can skip this tour.
activityApprove.step1Body: Filter «Submitted» (automatic) — the list shows only camps and events for release. Type «Activity» is hidden here (goes straight to the material manager).
activityApprove.step2Body: Double-click the highlighted row (camp/event) — or tap «Next» in the tour to open the details.
activityApprove.step3Body: Review usage and material pickup/return. Reject or ask for changes if needed.
activityApprove.step4Body: In the «Material» tab you see the demand. If it looks right, continue to release.
activityApprove.step5Body: Tap «Confirm» / release at the top — status becomes confirmed. Then MW/DC can accept and pack.

workshopOverview.title: Workshop
workshopOverview.description: Handle repairs and damage separately in the workshop.
workshopOverview.step1Body: Under Workshop you see open tickets from returns and damage reports.
workshopOverview.step2Body: Filter by phase and open a ticket — best once damage or losses were reported.
workshopOverview.step3Body: In the ticket you document work, loss, or handoff to a supplier.

packList.mwHandoffWorkflowConfirmMessage: You set the activity status to At event. Material already booked to the event counts as at event; the rest on the pack list stays Packed. As material manager you bypass the group.
packList.confirmWorkflowStatusMessage: {count} line(s) are not yet booked to the event and will stay Packed. Set the activity status to At event anyway?
packList.toastNothingAtEventYet: Book at least one line or crate to the event before setting the status.
packList.moveAllTitle: Moves all open lines from Packed to «{stage}» (pack list only, activity status unchanged).
packList.workflowTransitionTitle: Sets the activity status to «{status}» (without moving remaining quantities).
packList.issueToEventCombinedTitle: Moves everything from Packed to At event and sets the activity status to At event.
packList.issueToEventCombinedTitleMw: Emergency: issue material to event and set status At event — normally done by the group.
packList.mwOpenPackingWorkBannerBody: At least one line is not fully packed yet. Use tab «{stage}» to pack (arrows). Then book on «Packed → At event» — with confirmation, because the group normally issues material.
packList.mwLooseCrateAssignmentBannerTitle: Late add-on: assign to pack crate
packList.mwLooseCrateAssignmentBannerBody: New material is under «Packed» but not yet in a pack crate. Open tab «{stage}»: add a pack crate if needed, select it at the top, then use the green up arrow (↑) under «Without container». Then continue on «Packed → At event» as usual.
packList.mwLooseCrateAssignmentTabSwitchToast: Opened «Confirmed → Packed» — select a crate and assign the material.
packList.mwHandoffBannerBody: Material is packed. The group issues items to the event — not the material manager except in an emergency. Forward arrows (→) and emergency buttons above work with confirmation; back arrows and status revert are locked.
packList.mwHandoffConfirmTitle: Issue to event as material manager?
packList.mwHandoffConfirmMessage: Normally the group (creator/members) moves material from Packed to At event. Continue only in an emergency.
packList.mwHandoffCombinedConfirmMessage: This step is for the creator and group members: move everything from Packed to At event and set the activity status to At event. As material manager you are bypassing the group.
packList.mwReturnHandoffBannerBody: Material is at the event. The group records returns — not the material manager except in an emergency. Forward arrows (→) and emergency buttons above work with confirmation; back arrows and status revert are locked.
packList.mwHandoffRevertLocked: Status revert and back arrows are locked during the group handoff. Forward (→) only in an emergency with confirmation.
packList.mwReturnHandoffConfirmMessage: Normally the group (creator/members) moves material from At event to Return. Continue only in an emergency.
packList.mwReturnHandoffWorkflowConfirmMessage: You set the activity status to Returned. Material already marked as returned counts as returned; the rest on the pack list stays At event. As material manager you bypass the group.
packList.packStageViewOnlyBanner: View only — items cannot be moved on this tab. Tab: “{stageLeft} → {stageRight}”.
packList.packStageCompletedBannerHint: The packing list is read-only. Progress hints (e.g. not yet at event) no longer apply — returns and put-away are done.
packList.packStageViewFutureHint: You are viewing a later step. Forward booking is not available here.
packList.packStageViewPastHint: You are viewing an earlier step. Moving items back is not available here.
packList.packStageOpenIssueRemainderHint: The activity status is already At event. Items still on the left as Packed can be booked here with the green arrow (→) or Take everything — without setting the status again.
packList.mwOffStageForwardConfirmTitle: Issue additional items from an earlier tab?
packList.mwOffStageForwardConfirmMessage: You are on “{viewStage}”, but the activity status has already moved on (“{statusStage}”). Only book forward here in an emergency.
packList.mwOffStageBackConfirmTitle: Move items back from an earlier tab?
packList.mwOffStageBackConfirmMessage: You are on “{viewStage}”, but the activity status has already moved on (“{statusStage}”). Only book backward here in an emergency.
packList.toastPackStageViewOnly: Switch to the tab matching the current activity status — this tab is view only.
packList.confirmPackedBackTitle: Back to “Confirmed” — return material to warehouse?
packList.confirmPackedBackMessage:
The pack booking will be reversed (Packed → Confirmed). Physically put the items back at their storage location / rack — otherwise stock and availability will be wrong.

Continue only if the items are actually back in the material manager warehouse.
packList.issueCrateAllTitleMw: Emergency: book entire crate to event (usually the group)
packList.issueLineLooseTitleMw: Emergency: take {count} items loose to event (usually the group)
packList.progressPendingIntro: Packed and At event are separate: material packed in a crate only counts once you click the green arrow (→).
packList.progressPendingActionLoose: Still loose — book with green arrow (→) on the left
packList.progressPendingActionInCrate: Already packed — click green arrow (→) in «{crate}»
packList.progressPendingActionInCrateWithGap: Book with arrow (→) in «{crate}» ({missing} missing per crate check)
packList.progressPendingActionInCrateGeneric: Already packed — click green arrow (→) in the crate below
packList.progressPendingActionMixed: {loose}× loose on the left, {inCrate}× in «{crate}» — use arrow (→) for each
packList.progressPendingActionMixedNoCrate: {loose}× loose on the left, {inCrate}× in crate — use arrow (→) for each
packList.progressPendingActionDefault: Book to At event with green arrow (→)
packList.confirmReturnWorkflowStatusMessage: {count} line(s) are not yet returned and will stay At event. Report return anyway? The material manager will be notified.
packList.toastNothingAtEventForReturnYet: Book at least one line to the event before reporting return.
packList.progressPendingReturnActionLoose: Still at event — return with green arrow (→) on the left
packList.progressPendingConsumableConsumption: Record consumption on the right under «Consumption» (do not use the return arrow)
packList.progressPendingConsumableMixed: Also record {n} pcs. consumption on the right under «Consumption»
packList.progressPendingReturnActionInCrate: Click green arrow (→) in «{crate}» to return
packList.progressPendingReturnActionInCrateGeneri: Click green arrow (→) in the crate below to return
packList.progressPendingReturnActionMixed: {loose}× loose on the left, {inCrate}× in «{crate}» — use arrow (→) to return
packList.progressPendingReturnActionMixedNoCrate: {loose}× loose on the left, {inCrate}× in crate — use arrow (→) to return each
packList.workflowRevertToPackingMessage:
The activity status will be set to Packing. Pack bookings are kept — you can correct quantities in the pack list.

Continue only if nothing has been issued to the event yet.
packList.workflowRevertToPackedMessage: The activity status will be set to Packed. Material already booked to the event stays in the pack list under At event — it is not automatically reversed.
packList.workflowRevertToAtEventMessage: The activity status will be set to At event. Recorded returns stay in the pack list — they are not automatically undone.
packList.returnStockBody: Record returns here (move lines to “Return”, adjust quantities). If more arrives physically than planned, set the actual quantity accordingly. To book back into stock: create a batch on the material or record goods receipt — e.g. consumables, food, or other items with expiry/batches.
packList.unpackWarehouseBody: The group has returned material — open crates, verify contents against the return, and put items back at their storage location. Consumption is already booked.
packList.hintUnpackLoose: Material returned outside of a crate.
packList.hintUnpackCratesOnRight: Returned crates: verify contents and put back in stock.
packList.hintUnpackCratesOnLeft: Returned crates — compare with issued quantities, then store item by item.
packList.hintUnpackCratesStoredRight: Fully stored crates and loose quantities.
packList.notTakenIssuedQty: {n} of {issued} issued — not taken to event
packList.hintNotTakenForUnpack: Never issued, or issued but not taken to the event — no return expected for these quantities.
packList.hintUnpackCrateCheck: Open the crate, verify quantities, then put items back at storage location/rack.
packList.hintUnpackPhysicalComboCrate: Physical combo — store the whole crate at once (contents and shell together).
packList.unpackReturnBalanceMismatch: Balance: {out} out of warehouse ≠ return {retour} + consumed {consumed} + loss {loss} + repair {repair}
packList.unpackCrateNoReturnedLines: No returned lines in this crate.
packList.warehouseOnlyInContainers: In containers only — see “Crates” below in this column.
packList.consumableQtySplit: {warehouse} from original activity order · {replenishment} reordered (purchase add-on)
packList.pipelineNotYetPackedShort: Not yet packed — record the quantity in the «Confirmed → Packed» stage.
packList.selectCrateHint: Select a crate (highlighted), then use the green arrow on the left to assign packed items into it.
packList.selectCrateAtEventHint: Tap a packing crate (green outline) — the green up arrow appears on the left for assigning items.
packList.activeCrateAssignHint: Assigning to «{label}» — use the green up arrow on loose packed (left) or loose at event (right) lines.
packList.activeCrateAssignHintLooseAtEvent: Loose at-event lines: green up arrow into «{label}» — or «Into container» when no crate is selected.
packList.returnShellAfterContentsHint: Return the pack contents first, then hand over the container (empty shell).
packList.toastReturnShellAfterContents: Return all lines in the crate first, then the container.
packList.confirmReturnWholeCrateMessage: Return the whole crate «{label}» with all open lines, or only this one line?
packList.hintNoContainersIssue: No containers yet. On “Confirmed → Packed”, use “Add container” to create one.
packList.hintContainersOnRight: All containers issued to the event are on the right under “{stage}”.
packList.hintReturnCratesOnRight: Crate contents return with the crate to the warehouse — including crates that never went to the event.
packList.hintReturnCratesOnLeft: Return crates at the event — contents travel back to the warehouse with the crate.
packList.selfProvidedLeaderIntro: These parts are not packed from stock — the activity creator organises them.
packList.hintConsumedForReturn: Consumable material used at the event — not physically returned.
packList.hintConsumableOverviewMw: Group/leader can book consumption anytime (Consumables tab / «Used»). Accounting task only after the activity is completed.
packList.hintConsumableOverviewUser: Book consumption in the Consumables tab or via «Used» — accounting is handled by the materials lead at completion.
packList.hintNotTakenForReturn: Never packed or packed but never issued to the event — still on the packing list (not yet returned).
packList.toastConsumableAllUsedNothingToReturn: Consumption recorded — nothing left to return physically.
packList.lineInCrateWarehouseReturn: {n} pcs. in crate (still in warehouse, return)
packList.unissueTitle: Undo issue — {count} pcs. back to “Packed” (incl. crate if applicable)
packList.issueRestTitle: Book remainder “{stage}” — {count} pcs. (incl. crate if applicable)
packList.issueCrateAllTitle: Book everything from this crate to the event
packList.issueCrateShellTakeTitle: Take empty packing crate to event
packList.issueCrateShellTakeTitleMw: Emergency: take empty packing crate to event (usually the group)
packList.issueCrateShellTakeHint: Contents were booked loose — you can still take the empty packing crate to the event.
packList.toastIssueContainerShellFailed: Could not book packing crate to event.
packList.issueLineLooseWithoutCrateTitle: Issue loose to event — pack crate «{crate}» stays at warehouse ({count} pcs)
packList.confirmIssueLooseWithoutCrateMessage:
Issue {qty}× {material} loose for «{activityName}» ({activityType}) to the event?

The pack crate stays at the warehouse and will not be taken along.
packList.issueLineLooseWithoutCrateTransportBackT: Individual return transport — pack crate «{crate}» stays at event ({count} pcs)
packList.confirmIssueLooseWithoutCrateTransportBa:
Book {qty}× {material} individually to “Return transport”?

Pack crate «{crate}» stays at the event — only the contents are transported.
packList.lineNotYetIssuedCrateGap: {rem} / {packed} not yet “{stage}” ({missing} missing per crate check)
packList.transportLeftEmptyAllOnRight: Everything recorded for outbound transport — see the right column. Open quantities are in Crates below.
packList.transportLeftEmptyNothingYet: Nothing transported yet — use the arrow to the right or open crates below.
packList.ariaContainersAtEventMirror: Containers at event (same view as left)
packList.targetLooseTitle: Active target: move material from containers with the arrow into loose quantity
packList.hintNoContainersConfirmed: No containers yet. Tap “Add container” next to “{stage}” above — the crate appears indented here.
packList.pullFromContainerTitle: Move quantity from container into loose quantity
packList.addCrateTitle: Find and assign available IS containers / stock crates
packList.addPackCrateSingleTitle: Add a stock crate to this pack list
packList.addMaterialToggleSummary: While packing: new lines appear on the left under “Confirmed”. When already packed: new quantity counts as packed (stage “Packed → …”). Adjust quantities in the pack list (arrows / stages), not on the “Material” tab.
packList.addMaterialHint: Choosing the same material again books additional quantity—if something is already partly packed, make sure you really need more stock versus adjusting packing progress.
packList.addMaterialTargetCrateHint: Material is placed directly into the selected crate after adding (while packing, it is moved to “Packed” first).
packList.addMaterialTargetNoCrates: Add a crate under “Packed” above first to book material directly into it.
packList.toastMaterialAddToCrateFailed: Could not book material into the crate.
packList.returnCrateModalIntro: Compare the physical contents with the packing list. Items may have been moved to another crate or booked loose — only what is physically in the crate matters.
packList.returnCrateModalLoadingContents: Loading stock contents of the crate…
packList.returnCrateModalContentsError: Could not load the stock template — please verify contents manually.
packList.returnCrateModalNoBatchHint: No stock crate ID linked: all lines come from the packing list. Check physically.
packList.returnCrateModalExtraHint: Some lines are not in this crate’s stock documentation — please verify explicitly.
packList.returnCrateModalExtraNote: These items are not part of the documented baseline stock in this crate; they may have been added for the activity.
packList.returnCrateModalLooseNote: Still at the event but not travelling back inside this crate.
packList.returnCrateModalAddedNote: Physically in the crate but beyond the expected baseline.
packList.returnCrateModalSearchHint: More material in the crate? Add from this activity:
packList.returnCrateModalSearchEmpty: No matching material in this activity.
packList.returnCrateModalEmptyLines: No packing lines in this container — check the crate itself only.
packList.returnCrateModalExtraBooked: Extra {n} pcs recorded — return qty updated
packList.returnCrateModalLineHint: Adjust return qty. If less: consumption, loss or repair. If more: Extra.
packList.returnCrateModalWetHungNo: Still needs to be hung up
packList.modalAddHint: Crates marked “container” on the material or on the serial instance (without physical combo reference). Empty crates appear at the top of the list; others show “with contents”. Excluded: already on this packing list or overlapping planning/usage with another activity.
packList.modalScanHint: Scan a crate QR code — the matching crate will be pre-selected in the list.
packList.modalScanInvalid: Not a valid material/batch QR code.
packList.modalScanNotContainer: Scanned material is not a crate/container.
packList.modalScanNotAvailable: This crate is not available (already on the packing list, in use elsewhere, or not matching stock).
packList.modalNoBatch: No crate available: either no matching stock (container on material or instance, booked on rack), or all crates are already on this packing list / another overlapping activity.
packList.modalAssignMaxWithContainers: Max. {max} loose — {packed} packed, {inContainers} already in containers (not warehouse crate stock)
packList.modalAssignNoContainers: Use “Add container” above first to create a crate.
packList.modalAssignLoadingChoices: Loading containers and activity material list…
packList.toastShellContainerCreateFailed: Could not create or link the pack container from the activity list.
packList.confirmShellCrateForwardMessage: You are advancing the unit “{label}” as on the packing list. Please verify physically that everything assigned is in the crate—including extras recorded in container lines. Continue?
packList.confirmShellCrateBackMessage: You are moving the unit “{label}” back. Does the physical contents still match the packing list? Adjust extras under “Crates” / container lines if needed.
packList.shellBackIntro: You are moving “{label}” ({n} pcs.) from «{from}» back to «{to}».
packList.shellBackRetourHint: Only the packing list status is reset. Stock moved into the crate during the crate check stays in the crate — adjust in material master if needed.
packList.shellBackAcknowledge: I understand the crate contents and deviations; the pack status may be reset
packList.shellBackDeviationReplenish: added from stock ({n}×) — remains in crate
packList.shellEmbedExtraHint: Book add-on items in this crate individually:
packList.cratePeekNoShellYet: No warehouse crate linked to this physical combo — contents appear after assigning a crate on the material or adding a pack container.
packList.cratePeekComboBomEmpty: No bill of materials defined for this physical combo yet.
packList.cratePeekEmptyLinkedCrate: The linked warehouse crate has no documented contents (empty or not recorded in stock). Extra items appear after adding a pack container.
packList.shellForwardIntro: You are booking “{label}” ({n} pcs.) to the next stage. Compare the packing list with what is physically in the crate.
packList.shellForwardIntroGroup: You are taking “{label}” ({n} pcs.) to the event. Quickly count what is in the crate.
packList.shellForwardWizardHintGroup: For each line: enter the counted quantity and confirm with ✓.
packList.shellForwardAllPresent: Checked: everything on the packing list is present
packList.shellForwardLineNoteNotTakenPlaceholder: e.g. deliberately not packed, stays in stock …
packList.shellForwardNeedAllLines: Check every line with ✓ (present) or the red X (issue / choose “more than listed”).
packList.shellForwardNeedAllLinesGroup: Count each line and confirm with ✓ — if quantities differ, the count is enough.
packList.shellForwardGroupShortMsg: {n} pcs. short — this will be logged and the material manager will be notified.
packList.shellForwardGroupSurplusMsg: {n} pcs. more than planned — this will be logged and the material manager will be notified.
packList.shellForwardGroupDeviationBanner: Some items differ from the packing list. You can still continue — the material manager will see the details in their inbox.
packList.shellForwardGroupPrefillHintOne: Last check: “{name}” — {counted} of {soll} pcs in the crate ({missing} missing). Is that still correct? Verify the quantity and confirm with ✓.
packList.shellForwardGroupPrefillHintMany: Last check: {lines}. Is that still correct? Please verify and confirm with ✓.
packList.shellForwardNote: What is missing or needs checking?
packList.shellForwardSubmitWithProtocol: Continue booking — {label}: log and apply discrepancies
packList.shellForwardSubmitHintPickAction: For each red X line, pick an action (e.g. “Not taken” or “Add from stock”). Filling quantity and note alone is not enough — you must choose a button.
packList.shellForwardNeedCheckbox: Complete the check, or record discrepancies with an action on each affected line.
packList.shellForwardProblemNeedDetails: For issues: pick an action; for “Not taken”, enter quantity and/or a note (an issue report is created).
packList.notTakenReminderIntro: These lines were recorded that way at issue — not an activity loss. When putting stock back, reconcile with the crate. An inspection ticket is created in the workshop for follow-up.
packList.repackIssuesModalIntro: There are open reports for affected materials — they default to ✓ “still applies”. Use ✗ if wrong (resolve on Reports first); keep ✓ otherwise. Notes and buttons appear on one line.
packList.repackIssuesNeedEachOk: Please choose ✓ on every report (still applies) before booking.
packList.repackIssueMarkedProblemHint: If you chose ✗: update or resolve the report on the “Reports” tab, then set ✓ here.
packList.physicalComboIssueModalIntro: Physical combo: select the BOM parts affected (not the combo as a whole).
packList.physicalComboIssueModalMultiHint: Multiple parts selected — the damage wizard will open for each part in turn.
packList.physicalComboIssueModalEmpty: No reportable components in the BOM — report on the combo directly.
packList.shellForwardOpenReportsEmbeddedHint: Open reports appear on the matching packing list line below, or under “Other reports”. Type, note, and ✓/✗ toggles default to ✓ (still applies).
packList.shellForwardHistoryPrefillHint: Last crate check on {date}: checklist states were restored where safe. «Add from stock» is shown as ✓ present—the move was already booked; nothing is moved again on submit. Lines with loss/repair/not-taken are not pre-selected (another submit would move stock or create duplicate reports)—please verify and set again if needed.
packList.shellForwardReplenishedFromStockHint: Already added from stock (last crate check)—will not be booked again.
packList.shellForwardSubmitUnlockHint: You can continue when every line is ✓ or has a red X with a valid action, and every embedded report (or under “Other reports”) is confirmed with ✓. If you only confirm “Not taken” reports, that action is selected for you automatically.
packList.shellForwardSubmitBlockedNow: Blocked: for example a red line without a chosen action, or a report not yet confirmed with ✓.
packList.shellForwardOrphanIssuesTitle: Other reports for this crate (not assigned to a line)
packList.shellForwardRepackIssuesPickHint: Reports default to ✓; choose ✗ if they no longer apply, then adjust on the Reports tab.
packList.shellForwardSubmitErrorNotCrate: This line is not a pack crate — crate check is not available. Please contact the material manager.
packList.shellForwardSubmitErrorNotEditable: The pack list cannot be edited in the current status.
packList.shellForwardMoveAfterCheckFailed: Content check saved, but forwarding failed. Please try again with the arrow.
packList.crateCheckPendingBannerBody: Physical combos and pack containers (crate, bag, …): each person checks the contents (BOM) before moving — «Check contents» or the green arrow. Other members' checks do not count. Loose items (e.g. torches) do not need a check.
packList.toastMoveAllBlockedCrateCheck: Cannot move all: {count} container(s) still need a content check ({names}). Please check first.
packList.repeatCrateCheckIntro: Re-count the contents of “{label}” and save the result.
packList.shellForwardIncompleteToastGroup: Continued to event — discrepancies were logged.
packList.shellForwardIncompleteToastMw: Crate logged with discrepancies and booked forward.
packList.shellForwardNoIssuePermission: No permission to create reports — please contact an administrator.
packList.confirmStillInContainerWhenReturnMessage: For “{name}”, some quantity is still issued via container lines. If you move loose quantity back here: have you adjusted the physical crate contents or corrected the container lines first?
packList.confirmStillInContainerWhenPackedBackMes: “{name}” is still partly assigned to a container. Usually remove the quantity under “Crates” first. Move loose packed quantity back anyway?
packList.toastIssueContainerFailed: Could not book container to event.
packList.toastUnstoreLineSuccess: {qty} pcs. moved back to «still to store»
packList.unpackUnstoreTitle: Undo storage — back to the left column
packList.confirmUnpackUnstoreMessage:
You are moving {qty}× «{name}» back to «still to store» (left column).

In the pack list they will no longer count as stored — but they may already be physically in the material manager warehouse. Only continue if you need to correct the booking (e.g. wrong quantity or stored by mistake).
packList.issueReportPickerHint: Choose the type of report — the report wizard follows next.
packList.physComboStoreChecklistIntro: Check off every component. When everything is present, book the complete set into the warehouse.
packList.physComboStoreOpenIssuesTitle: Open reports — clarify or replenish before storing:
packList.toastAssignLooseActive: “Loose” is active: move material from a container with the arrow into loose quantity. For “Into container”, click a container.
packList.toastNothingLeftToIssue: Nothing left to issue (check packing line or container row).
packList.toastNoPackLine: No packing line for this material.
packList.toastIssueLineLooseSuccess: {qty} pcs. issued loose to event — removed from crate
packList.toastNothingToUnissue: Nothing to undo (check packing line or container row).
packList.toastMoveToContainerDirect: From Confirmed to Packed — placed directly into the selected container.
packList.confirmDeleteMessage: “{label}” and all assignments inside will be removed.
packList.confirmWorkflowMessage: {count} line(s) are not fully moved yet. Continue anyway?

completion.title: Material completion
completion.lead: Before «Complete», all material must be cleared (stored or reported as loss/repair).
completion.allClear: Material cleared — the activity can be completed. Accounting runs separately.
completion.itemStorageHint: Shelve by rack on the packing list — tap a line and confirm «Stored». Loss/repair reports count as cleared.
completion.itemIssuesHint: Info — does not block completion. Reported loss/repair already counts as disposition.
completion.itemWorkshopHint: Info — does not block completion. Costs follow in accounting once tickets are done.
completion.itemAccountingAfterCloseHint: Accounting tasks are often created only after «Complete» — assign them in accounting, not here.
completion.itemAccountingHint: Info — does not block completion. Assign open follow-ups in accounting.
completion.itemCostsReviewHint: Optional: review the cost overview — consumables, workshop and purchases. Does not block completion.
completion.itemCostsNoneHint: Nothing to release — this step is done.
completion.releaseHint: Accounting tasks are often created only after «Complete».

vehicles.title: Vehicles
vehicles.intro: Plan vehicles for this activity — often rented from external companies. Enter payload (load capacity), not gross/total vehicle weight. Tours in the pack list only use this list.
vehicles.searchHint: Search existing department (and partner) vehicles and add them to this activity.
vehicles.searchEmpty: No matching vehicle — create a new one if needed.
vehicles.recentEmpty: No recently used vehicles yet — type a name or plate to search.
vehicles.recentSearchesEmpty: No searches yet — type a name or plate.
vehicles.historyTilesHint: Sorted by last used — tap to assign.
vehicles.historyEmpty: No known vehicles yet — search by name or plate, or create a new one.
vehicles.fieldPayloadHint: Load capacity in kg — not the vehicle's gross/total weight.
vehicles.fieldAssignmentNotes: Note for this activity (e.g. rental period)

costs.lossNoPriceHint: Without a sale price in master data, losses cannot be charged in CHF.
costs.lossWorkshopHint: Loss and repair: actual costs are recorded in the workshop; billing uses the material owner's department (internal) or the external customer (rental).
costs.releaseLead: Review the overview and release costs for completion.
costs.releaseHint: Accounting tasks are created only after «Complete» — then assign them in accounting.
costs.releaseConfirmLead: Please review the billing target and total again before releasing.
costs.collectionNoteLead: Optional: note if you just collected cash or issued an invoice. Not a finished booking.
costs.collectionNoteOfferLead: Per settings you can note collection here — cash or invoice. Booking still happens in accounting.
costs.collectionNoteHint: Final settlement stays in accounting (follow-up → booking).
costs.accountingLead: One task per cost type (consumables combined per activity, workshop per ticket, external rental separate).
costs.accountingHandoffLead: These tasks were created on completion — pending assignment or already booked.
costs.accountingHandoffEmpty: No accounting tasks for this activity.
costs.purchasesNote: Follow-up purchase prices — visible as soon as recorded. Accounting task (cost centre) only after the activity is completed; «Material dept.» = item owner; «Recorded by» = who entered the replenishment.

consumables.title: Consumables
consumables.intro: Book consumed material here — at most the quantity booked for this activity. Consumption is deducted from stock.
consumables.qtySplit: {warehouse} pcs. from stock · {replenishment} pcs. follow-up / purchase
consumables.replenishmentSectionHint: Follow-up purchases visible to everyone. Accounting task only when the activity is completed — until then see the activity «Costs» tab.
consumables.blockedHintWithNachbuchung: Consumption limit reached. Add a delivery or assign leftovers to the event:
consumables.blockedHintNoRights: No further consumption possible. Increasing booked quantity only via materials lead / dept. lead (Material tab).
consumables.handoffReadOnlyHint: Material handed to the materials lead — no further consumption bookings are possible.
consumables.costsHint: Charged consumption: from stock at sale price, from follow-up purchases at recorded purchase price.
consumables.surplusHint: {n} pcs still booked but not consumed — e.g. leftovers from a purchase.
consumables.costsNoneYet: No consumption booked yet — amount CHF 0.00
consumables.costsZeroWithUsage: Consumption is booked but the amount is CHF 0.00 (missing sale price or warehouse stock without price).
consumables.costsMissingSalePrice: Consumption is booked but without a sale price in the material master data nothing can be charged. Add the sale price on the material (e.g. torches) — the amount will appear here; an accounting task for group billing is created only when the activity is completed.

keyDates.title: Key date ranges
keyDates.hint: Fixed dates for this major event — shown as quick selection in date fields.
keyDates.empty: No fixed dates yet. The event period is created automatically on setup; add more under Settings → Fixed dates.

feinPartner.title: Committed articles in detail planning
feinPartner.intro: Preview: once a partner says yes, the article belongs in the detail round — so departments tighten their wish window to the partner window instead of keeping the loan longer than needed.
feinPartner.wishGatorWide: Gator all of the week before plus the event (safety)

advice.wide: Shorten the period in the detail round — a shorter loan is better for the partner.
advice.fit: The wish sits inside the committed window. Do not book over handover or return.
advice.none: Create the article and align the detail-round period with the partner window.

ressorts.emptyDescription: Create departments and sub-projects, assign members and structure the event.
ressorts.subtitleMw: Manage departments and sub-projects, assign members.
ressorts.subtitleMember: Add sub-projects in your department and assign members.
ressorts.emptyNoMembers: No members in this node yet.
ressorts.helperHint: Name and email are enough. The person becomes a Grossanlass member (no material-chief rights), is assigned to this department, and gets a user card for issue.
ressorts.deleteMessage: Really delete «{name}» and empty sub-projects? Only possible without members in the entire branch.

rounds.emptyDescription: Only material wishes are later bundled into packages in procurement.
rounds.subtitleMw: Three forms: material wish (demand), company tip (inquiries) and free (ideas). Coarse and fine are stages of the same material wish.
rounds.subtitleMember: Fill in open forms. You can refine material wishes later when a fine round is open.
rounds.closeConfirmMessage: Really close «{name}»? Department members will no longer be able to submit new wishes. Existing wishes are kept.
rounds.reopenConfirmMessage: Reopen «{name}»? Department members can submit and edit wishes again.
rounds.closesAtEnableHint: Optional — without a closing time the form stays open until it is closed manually.
rounds.closesAtRequired: Set a closing time or turn the option off.
rounds.windowInvalid: Closing time must be after the opening time.
rounds.autoScheduleHint: Opens automatically at the set time. Enable «Closes at» to also close automatically.
rounds.autoScheduleNeedsOpens: An opening time is required for the schedule.
rounds.opened: «{name}» is now open — department members were notified

wishForms.pickPurposeIntro: Pick the type first. Material wishes feed demand, company tips go to inquiries, free stays an ideas inbox.
wishForms.purposeHintMaterial: What, quantity, place, period. Answers go into the demand pool — later bundled into packages for company inquiries.
wishForms.purposeHintCompany: Who do you know? No quantity catalogue. Suggestions for the inquiries tab; the material lead accepts or rejects.
wishForms.purposeHintFree: Ideas inbox. Takeover only as a material wish or company tip — never bundled automatically.
wishForms.grobFeinHint: Coarse and fine are not separate forms: the same material wish is refined later.
wishForms.feinHint: These are your coarse entries — now make them precise. No duplicates unless something extra is needed.
wishForms.landingMaterial: Only these forms feed demand. Procurement later bundles them into packages.
wishForms.landingCompany: Company tips as suggestions — not in the material demand pool.
wishForms.landingFree: Surveys and “what are we still missing” — the material lead takes over deliberately.
wishForms.emptyMaterialDescription: Create a form so departments can submit wishes. Only material goes into procurement.
wishForms.emptyCompanyDescription: Demo: departments name partners — the material lead takes them into inquiries.
wishForms.emptyFreeDescription: For surveys and rough ideas that must not enter demand automatically.
wishForms.namePlaceholderFree: e.g. What are we still missing?
wishForms.previewCreated: Form created in preview (this session only, no API)
wishForms.builderHintCompany: Core fields are preset — you can rename them. Extra questions like Material, without a quantity catalogue.
wishForms.builderHintFree: Empty builder: pick and name fields yourself. Nothing goes into demand automatically.
wishForms.builderEmptyHint: Use «Add field» to create questions and label them.
wishForms.samplesEmpty: No entries in this preview yet.

wishForms.demoFreeSample1: More wheelbarrows at the water works

struktur.intro: Sub-warehouses, participant departments and how the event is organised.
struktur.modusHint: Controls how sub-warehouses and guest departments relate.

activities.intro: Phase activities (setup, event, teardown) and optional pre-events.
activities.mainHint: Period comes from master data — refinable later.

freigabe.intro: Guest departments are invited only after publish. Until then the event stays internal.
freigabe.publishHint: Invitations then go to the planned departments.

materials.title: Materials
materials.subtitle: Master data: owned, loaned, guests, vehicles.
materials.eigenIntro: Owned material — including single-use cut items and stock to resell cheaper.
materials.leihweiseIntro: Loaned material with source and period. Expand to see where it is in use.
materials.fahrzeugeIntro: Fleet: owned, loaned and vehicles planned for sale after the event.

gaeste.intro: Invited departments: collect J&S quantities and material they lend to the event. Accepted loans can be booked as deployments. Preview, no API.
gaeste.jsHint: Each department fills the same J&S catalogue. Totals here — one order to BASPO, not 40 PDFs.
gaeste.loanHint: A guest department lends material to the event. Accept → bookable in deployments. Issue later in the material overview.
gaeste.acceptedToast: Loan accepted — now bookable in deployments.

materials.tableEmpty: No entries yet — preview without data.
materials.tableHint: Single-click expands issue details. Double-click opens the article detail view.
materials.detailNotFoundDescription: This demo article is not in the preview catalogue.

zusage.dialogHint: This session only, no API. After a yes from the partner, the article exists with their window — deployments only after that.
zusage.fieldReleaseHint: Until you release it, projects can see the article but cannot book it. Handover and return stay blocked.
zusage.serviceHint: Cleaning, greasing and similar jobs occupy the vehicle — no deployment in that slot.
zusage.createdToast: Article noted for this session only — nothing is saved to the database.
zusage.windowIntro: Partner window, fixed handover/return and release for deployments. Makes it obvious when the item is actually there.
zusage.noWindow: This demo article has no partner window (owned stock without a loan day).

materialUebersicht.title: Material overview
materialUebersicht.subtitle: Stock, deployments and conflicts — what stays in the warehouse and where it is needed.
materialUebersicht.intro: Search barcode or name — expand to see central stock, pickups and consumption per department / sub-project. Demo data, accordion stays closed.
materialUebersicht.einsaetzeIntro: Main groups: vehicle fleet, tools, material. Hatch = not on site or not released yet. Bars: deployment, handover, return, yard service.
materialUebersicht.konflikteIntro: Only double bookings and quantities above stock. Empty means no conflicts.
materialUebersicht.emptyRow: No deployments in this period — free.
materialUebersicht.ganttHint: Month, week or day (00–24). White space is free. Hover or tap a bar for booking details.
materialUebersicht.timelineHint: Fri setup · Sat event · Sun return — demo timeline, not a live booking.
materialUebersicht.conflictUniqueText: {a} and {b} both want the same {name} on Saturday 10–14. Block, shorten or move the second booking.
materialUebersicht.conflictQtyText: Overlapping deployments need {used} pcs, {stock} pcs are available.
materialUebersicht.emptyConflictsText: No overlapping uniques and no overbooked quantities.
materialUebersicht.wishListHint: Demo: copy wish fields into a booking — nothing is saved. Busy slots can still be submitted; the materials lead coordinates.
materialUebersicht.composerHint: Demo, nothing saved: in the modal book yourself or search a submitted wish template.
materialUebersicht.sourceOwnHint: Pick a vehicle or material yourself — no wish.
materialUebersicht.sourceWishHint: Reuse a wish you already submitted.
materialUebersicht.pickEinsatz: Choose a template — wish or blank
materialUebersicht.bookFromWishBadge: Fields copied from the material wish
materialUebersicht.bookBlankHint: Object and time would be set later — demo fields only.
materialUebersicht.bookDialogHint: First choose: own booking or from a wish. Then set the time, and a driver for vehicles.
materialUebersicht.detailsHint: You can still change the time range. Vehicles need a chauffeur with drive permission, otherwise the item cannot be moved.
materialUebersicht.chauffeurHint: Only listed drivers with drive permission — checked later at issue.
materialUebersicht.chauffeurNoLicense: This person may not drive the vehicle. Pick another chauffeur or ask the materials lead.
materialUebersicht.orderHint: Reorder demo: not on the calendar, only a noted order on this page.
materialUebersicht.bookConflict: This slot is already planned. You cannot silently add another booking — the request goes to the materials lead as pending approval.
materialUebersicht.bookIssuedLock: This item is already issued in that period. Extra booking is locked. You can send a message to the materials lead.
materialUebersicht.bookUnreleased: The partner said yes, but the article is not released for deployments yet. Projects wait — you can send a message to the materials lead.
materialUebersicht.bookOutsideWindow: Outside the partner window (not on site, handover/return, or after valid_to). A deployment like this is not possible unless the materials lead agrees it with the partner.
materialUebersicht.pendingMwHint: Locked until approval — message to the materials lead.
materialUebersicht.mwNoteSent: Message to the materials lead noted (this session only). The bar shows as planned pending approval.
materialUebersicht.slotLegendFree: Grey = already booked · Green = your choice
materialUebersicht.slotLegendClash: Grey = already booked · Red = your choice (busy)
materialUebersicht.slotContinues: Selection continues past this day until {to}.
